# Review: Atlas deployment tool
https://news.example/tools/atlas-review

Published 2026-01-10.
Atlas is a solid internal deployment tool. The Team plan costs $35 per seat per month.
Export is limited to CSV; Parquet support is promised for a later release.
Verdict: recommended for small ops teams.

Links:
- https://atlas.example/
- https://atlas.example/pricing

# Atlas - internal deployment tool
https://atlas.example/

Atlas is the internal deployment tool for the Atlas rollout.
It is owned and maintained by the ops team.
Current stable release: 1.2.0.

Links:
- https://atlas.example/docs
- https://atlas.example/pricing
- https://atlas.example/blog/2026-03-release-1-2
- https://status.example/atlas

# Atlas pricing
https://atlas.example/pricing

Team plan: $40 per seat per month, billed annually. Includes 5 concurrent deployments.
Enterprise plan: custom pricing, contact sales@atlas.example.
Prices effective 2026-02-01. The 2025 price list has been retired.

Links:
- https://atlas.example/pricing/2025
- https://atlas.example/docs/limits

# Atlas rate limits and quotas
https://atlas.example/docs/limits

API requests: 600 per minute per API key.
Concurrent deployments: 5 per project.
Webhook delivery retries: 8 attempts with exponential backoff (raised from 5 in release 1.2.0).
Last reviewed 2026-04-02.

Links:
- https://atlas.example/docs/changelog
